verdict.rationale: ADK provides a CLI command `adk run path/to/my_agent` to run agents headlessly from a terminal, which could be used to verify an agent that was just built, but the evidence doesn't specifically demonstrate this workflow for verifying newly-built example agents or agent-to-agent verification use cases. missing for 10: example agents shipped with the repo specifically for this purpose, documentation/evidence showing an agent invoking `adk run` on another agent to verify its own output, and independent hands-on confirmation of headless CLI verification workflows.
